guidance: Original optional starting directions. Supplied brands/templates and the requested medium override presets. Verify font availability and contrast before production.

presets.use: Proposals, executive briefs, and decision documents

presets.use: Software brochures, product explanations, and technical sales sheets

presets.use: Service brochures and company profiles with a narrative emphasis

presets.use: Trade-show one-pagers and concise introduction handouts
presets.layout: Clear category at first glance, one hero subject, restrained short copy and a visible contact action

presets.use: Restrained specialist business services and premium company introductions
